If I were one of the people reacting to the target post about Trump's executive order on homelessness, here's how I might respond in simple words:

I'd feel a mix of hope and worry. The idea of getting homeless people off the streets and into treatment centers sounds like it could help—especially if they’re struggling with addiction or mental health issues. It might make cities safer and give people a chance to get better. 
But I’d be concerned if there aren’t enough treatment centers or if people are forced into them against their will. 
I’d wonder where the money’s coming from and if it really solves the problem or just hides it. 
I’d also think about whether this could turn into something unfair, like punishing people for being homeless instead of helping them. 
I’d want to see more details about the plan before deciding if it’s a good or bad idea.
